text:
evan: Quick plan for a compact "Hands-on Labs" launch — short form tutorials + one tiny OSS refapp + a benchmark highlight and 1 live office hour. Need owners for blog post, benchmark narrative, LP, webinar, and routing.

soph: I can write the tutorial trio (two 5-min reads + 1 deep example). Want each to include a tiny runnable snippet and a link to the refapp repo.

lia: I'll run the benchmarks and surface a single hero stat plus reproducible CSV and a 3-line script. Planning to compare default vs batching+cache on a 300-token convo.

harry: I'll do landing page variants and the webinar ops. Suggest two LPs: Code-first hero (CTA: "Run the refapp now") and Story hero (CTA: "See cost & latency wins").

isla: Routing & email: recommend three segments — OSS contributors, trial users, and product evaluators. Drip: announce -> tutorial -> webinar -> replay. Also suggest a partner maintainers invite microflow.

eván: tiny correction: evan spelled with no accent in participants list.

evan: noted. Lia — for benchmark hero copy keep it conservative, e.g., "up to ~35% lower unit cost" and link to reproducible tests.

lia: Will do. Tentative hero line: "Interactive demos at ~30% lower unit cost with batching + cache" (will add p99 and median in the LP details).

soph: For tutorial snippets I'll include two CLI examples and one small Python example. Snippets will be <=4 lines each.

harry: Webinar format: 40m total — 20m demo, 15m live Q&A, 5m CTAs. Cap 400, record and auto-email replay. Want short clips for socials.

isla: Email copy variants: Subject A: "Hands-on Labs: 3 short tutorials + live office hour" Subject B: "Build a tiny refapp in minutes — join the workshop" Preheaders and CTAs will be dynamic by segment.

evan: Bench infra ask: 120 GPU minutes. Approve?

lia: 120 should be fine for one sweep across 3 models. I'll log runs under GH issue.

isla: Add triggers: if trial tokens > 5k OR repo stars > 2, move to maintainer/early-access stream. Also tag paid customers separately.

harry: LP design note: create a tiny animated terminal GIF for the code-first hero and a compact benchmark strip for the story hero. I'll spin mocks in Figma today.

soph: I'll add links to the OSS refapp and a short README checklist for maintainers. Plan to publish tutorial posts as a single series page + individual posts.

evan: Owners recap: Soph = tutorials & repo copy, Lia = benchmarks & reproducibles, Harry = LP & webinar ops, Isla = routing & email. Launch-bot, create GH issue "hands-on-labs-mini-launch" and remind in 36h.

launch-bot: Created issue #2010 "hands-on-labs-mini-launch" and set a 36h reminder.

lia: One blocker: need a tiny infra credit for benchmarks. Can we approve 120 GPU minutes now?

evan: Approved 120 GPU minutes, please attach OTP usage to the GH issue.

isla: I'll draft the email flows and share them in #marketing-drafts by tomorrow morning. Also will add UTM parameters and CRM mapping.

harry: Posting Figma link shortly. Will include A/B copy for hero CTAs.

soph: Draft tutorials ETA 48h. Will include code snippets and GIF assets.

evan: Great — aim to freeze copy/design by Friday. Flag any blockers here or on issue #2010. :rocket:
